mapper.select: select id, name, protocol, server, port, link, unix_timestamp(updated_at) * 1000 as updatedAt from vpn.user_node where user_name = #{name} order by updated_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into vpn.user_node(id, user_name, name, link, protocol, server, port, updated_at) values(#{node.id}, #{name}, #{node.name}, #{node.link}, #{node.protocol}, #{node.server}, #{node.port}, now())
mapper.update: update vpn.user_node set name = #{node.name}, link = #{node.link}, protocol = #{node.protocol}, server = #{node.server}, port = #{node.port}, updated_at = now() where id = #{node.id} and user_name = #{name}
mapper.delete: delete from vpn.user_node where id = #{id} and user_name = #{name}
